stage: additional experiment planned after review, before its intervention runs
source_exposure: Original source and earlier experiments already inspected; not blind discovery
symptom: The alpha/v2 request with k=1 returns empty evidence although b02 matches
setup: Run original R03 (beta/v1,k=1) to obtain an empty cached result naturally. Save that original cache and clone the identical starting state into each arm. Target is original R02 with k=1; original corpus and drafts unchanged.

hypotheses.cache: A prior empty result is reused because the key ignores scope. With warm cache and only scope-order repaired, evidence remains empty and cache_hit is true. With cache key repaired, cache_hit becomes false.
hypotheses.retrieval: A newly calculated result can also be empty because b01 consumes the single global top-k slot before version filtering. With cache key repaired alone, the miss still produces empty evidence; with both repairs it selects b02.

interpretation: Compatible mechanisms, not mutually exclusive guesses. The cached result is the earliest boundary in the warm original request; the retrieval mechanism remains a latent failure after cache bypass.
negative_control: With k=2 and the same warm empty cache, original still returns empty; cache-only repair restores b02 without any scope-order change. Thus the cache factor has an independently observable effect.
controls: Same target input, corpus, draft and starting cache in all main arms. No editing draft, no model calls, no redefining the old experiments.
stop: Preserve outputs and report mismatch if any prediction fails; do not rewrite the prediction after observing outputs.
